title.en: Introduction to Taiwan Income Tax and Tax Preferences for Foreign Professionals (Taipei)
title.zh: 外籍人士稅務說明會（台北場）

contents.en:
Getting ready for tax season? It doesn’t have to be complicated. Whether you’re a long-term foreign resident or new to Taiwan, navigating the tax system can be simpler—with the right guidance.

 

Talent Taiwan is hosting an informative tax workshop covering individual income tax, available tax incentives, and how to apply for them. Experts from Ernst & Young Taiwan</
contents.zh:
準備好迎接報稅季了嗎？別再為繁雜的程序感到頭痛！無論您是資深在台外籍人士，還是初來乍到的職場新人，報稅這條路，您不必獨自摸索。


Talent Taiwan 特別舉辦外國人稅務說明會，內容涵蓋個人所得稅、各項稅務優惠及其申請管道。我們特別邀請到 安永台灣 (Ernst & Young Taiwan) 的稅務專家，為您深度解析身為外籍專業人士應盡的義務與享有的權利。

organiser.zh: 國際人才服務及延攬中心

contents.zh:
